newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 486/487/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 486/487/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer at 486.00/487.00 per dollar in quiet trade after the Central Bank supplied the market with only moderate dollar sales, traders said.
"Demand was normal and trade quiet. The only unusual feature was that the Central Bank sold only very few dollars," said one trader.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
